scope: STATIC SOURCE ENDPOINTS ONLY. No generated frames, continuous motion, song synchronization, final edit, or full scene acceptance.

inspection.note: Scratch FFmpeg-only crops are review aids at native scale, not production inputs. New operator crops must preserve reviewed functional content and be bound to their own exact bytes.

pairs.observed: Both walk screen-right, woman slightly ahead, he shortens stride without touching. Full wrist-length burgundy sleeves restored; identities/coats stay consistent and complete feet are visible. Background progression is compatible with tracking.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Her endpoint stride phase is almost repeated. Accept only as a bounded gait-test source: actual take must show alternating support, independent natural cadence, his matched pace, real progress and no sliding/run-in-place. No mechanical foot-contact or timing pass from endpoints.

pairs.observed: Coated pair approach the same clinical entry then stop before the still-closed door, she nearest handle, he behind. Fixed cross pane/door remain present and all feet fit.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Actual braking/settling must be supported, with no shuffle loops or character overtaking. Subsequent V2-17 has its separately corrected door-opening source. No early opened door or fixed-pane disappearance.

authority: Root owns canon/contract changes. Artist and reviewer are separate. No generator or GPU operation performed by reviewer.
